title: 小型ユーティリティ運搬カート
description: 公園・キャンパス・施設構内の低速搬送シーンに置く汎用カート。低床四輪シャーシ、開いた両側乗降部、幅広ベンチ席、細い柱の屋根、操舵輪とペダル、座席後方の独立した開放荷台を備えます。荷台床リブ、側板、ヒンジ・ラッチ付き後部ゲート、車軸・板ばね表現・底部電動機ケース・灯火も造形。前の低い風除けは不透明な青灰色表現で、その上方と側面は開放。空荷の一式を1モデルと数え、走行・積載・開閉・電気動作、実機性能・荷重・安全性は未検証です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）1.410 × 1.915 × 3.255 m、28,468三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A generic utility cargo cart for low-speed transport scenes in parks, campuses and facility grounds. A low four-wheel chassis has open side entries, a broad bench seat, thin-post canopy, steering wheel and pedals, and a separate open cargo bed behind the seat. The bed includes floor ribs, side boards and a distinct hinged/latching tailgate; axles, visible leaf-spring detail, underside motor casing and inactive lamps are modeled. The short front wind deflector is opaque blue-grey, with open air above and on both sides. This empty whole assembly counts once. Driving, load handling, gate movement, electrical function, real-machine performance, load capacity and safety are unvalidated. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 1.410 × 1.915 × 3.255 m; 28,468 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
